name: Osman II
role: Sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1618 to 1622
contribution: The sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 26 February 1618 until his regicide on 20 May 1622.

checks.lead: Osman II (Ottoman Turkish: عثمان ثانى ‘Osmān-i sānī; Turkish: II. Osman; 3 November 1604 – 20 May 1622), also known as Osman the Young (Turkish: Genç Osman), was the sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 26 February 1618 until his regicide on 20 May 1622.
